production.metric: hourly AC kWh per installed kWp (MAE ≈ 0.018 on held-out test)
production.data_source: PVGIS hourly CSV + Open-Meteo historical reanalysis (İzmir, Ankara, İstanbul)
production.note: Generated by data/scripts/train_production_model_lgbm.py. If production_v1_lgbm.txt is absent or lightgbm isn't installed, backend/app/tools/production.py falls back to the v1-weather-regressor linear/physical blend automatically — see docs/research/PRODUCTION_MODEL_COMPARISON.md for why LightGBM was picked.

consumption.metric: 24-hour normalized load shape (RMSE ≈ 0.005 vs. TEDAŞ reference profiles)
consumption.data_source: TEDAŞ / ELDER published residential + commercial smart-meter aggregate profiles

optimizer.metric: daily TL cost minimization (greedy + 3-pass coordinate descent, interruptible-aware)
optimizer.data_source: EPDK regulated tariff tables (April 2026) + hourly net-metering regulation (May 2026)
optimizer.note: Deterministic device + battery scheduler. Saving computed as cost delta vs. habit-hour reference (±25% uncertainty range).
